# NOAH encoding metadata

The character-index table in `src/engines/mages/games/chaos-head-noah/sc3/glyph-unicode.ts` is adapted from [0xDC00/scripts](https://github.com/0xDC00/scripts/blob/afbaa140ae53c55eb32effb886326a72184286dc/PC_Steam_MAGES_CHAOS%3BHEAD_NOAH.js), under the accompanying MIT license. Only character encoding metadata is used; no hook code, game dialogue or font assets are included. Private-use and unmapped glyphs retain the native rendering for their entire slot. The reference targets the PC release; patched font atlases require their own verified mapping.
